content.stem: 以下哪一项是非政府组织（NGO）打击洗钱活动的常见策略？

options.A: 协助金融情报机构（FIU）分析可疑活动报告（SAR）
options.B: 直接在法庭上起诉洗钱者
options.C: 向各国政府提供财政援助，以加强其反洗钱工作
options.D: 提高对洗钱问题及其后果的认识

content.stem_en: Which of the following is a common strategy employed by non-governmental organizations (NGOs) to combat money laundering?

options_en.A: Helping Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs) to analyze suspicious activity reports (SARs)
options_en.B: Directly prosecuting money launderers in court
options_en.C: Providing financial assistance to governments to strengthen their anti-money laundering efforts
options_en.D: Raising awareness about the issue of money laundering and its consequences
